```{r gos-setup}
# GOS 通才/专才章节 / Generalist-specialist chapter.
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("SEED_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = getwd()), winslash = "/"), "R", "config.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "io.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "gos_core.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "sankey.R"))
suppressMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(patchwork); library(ggtree)})

GOS_TMP <- file.path(DERIVED_DIR, "gos")
GOS_TAB <- file.path(TAB_DIR, "gos")
GOS_FIG <- FIG_DIR
dir.create(GOS_TMP, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(GOS_TAB, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
HOST_TREE <- file.path(TREE_DIR, "plant_species_tree_all.nwk")
HOST_DIST_RDS <- file.path(GOS_TMP, "host_dist.rds")
for (f in c("host_dist.rds", "presence_merged_16s.rds", "presence_merged_its.rds",
            "nhost_null_16s_iter1000.rds", "nhost_null_its_iter1000.rds",
            "mpd_null_16s_rep1000.rds", "mpd_null_its_rep1000.rds",
            "gos_threshold_16s.rds", "gos_threshold_its.rds")) {
  src <- file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", f)
  dst <- file.path(GOS_TMP, f)
  if (!file.exists(dst)) file.copy(src, dst)
}
N_ITER <- 1000L; N_REP <- 1000L; ALPHA <- 0.05
GOS_CFG <- list(
  `16s` = list(
    css = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_16s_asvtab.txt"),
    meta = file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_16S.txt"),
    ref = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_Silva_filtered.fa"),
    tax = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "16S", "Merged_16S_taxonomy_filtered.txt"),
    merged_txt = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_merged_16s.txt"),
    merged_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_merged_16s.rds"),
    merge_log = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_species_merge_log_16s.csv"),
    nhost_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "nhost_null_16s_iter1000.rds"),
    mpd_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "mpd_null_16s_rep1000.rds"),
    info_csv = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_per_asv_info_16s.txt"),
    classified = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_classified_16s.txt"),
    threshold = file.path(GOS_TMP, "gos_threshold_16s.rds"),
    gen_fa = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_generalist_ref_16s.fa"),
    gen_tax = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_generalist_taxonomy_16s.txt"),
    spe_fa = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_specialist_ref_16s.fa"),
    spe_tax = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_specialist_taxonomy_16s.txt")),
  its = list(
    css = file.path(CSS_DIR, "merged", "css_its_asvtab.txt"),
    meta = file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata", "metadata_ITS.txt"),
    ref = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_Unite_filtered.fa"),
    tax = file.path(DATA_DIR, "filtered_merge", "ITS", "Merged_ITS_taxonomy_filtered.txt"),
    merged_txt = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_merged_its.txt"),
    merged_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_merged_its.rds"),
    merge_log = file.path(GOS_TMP, "presence_species_merge_log_its.csv"),
    nhost_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "nhost_null_its_iter1000.rds"),
    mpd_rds = file.path(GOS_TMP, "mpd_null_its_rep1000.rds"),
    info_csv = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_per_asv_info_its.txt"),
    classified = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_classified_its.txt"),
    threshold = file.path(GOS_TMP, "gos_threshold_its.rds"),
    gen_fa = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_generalist_ref_its.fa"),
    gen_tax = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_generalist_taxonomy_its.txt"),
    spe_fa = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_specialist_ref_its.fa"),
    spe_tax = file.path(GOS_TAB, "gos_specialist_taxonomy_its.txt"))
)
gos_host_dist(HOST_TREE, HOST_DIST_RDS)
```

```{r gos-presence}
# Step 1：0-1 矩阵 / Presence matrices.
mg_16s <- gos_presence_merge(GOS_CFG$`16s`$css, GOS_CFG$`16s`$meta, GOS_CFG$`16s`$ref,
  HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$`16s`$merged_txt, GOS_CFG$`16s`$merge_log,
  GOS_CFG$`16s`$merged_rds, "16s")
mg_its <- gos_presence_merge(GOS_CFG$its$css, GOS_CFG$its$meta, GOS_CFG$its$ref,
  HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$its$merged_txt, GOS_CFG$its$merge_log,
  GOS_CFG$its$merged_rds, "its")
for (f in c("presence_merged_16s.txt", "presence_merged_its.txt")) {
  if (!file.exists(file.path(GOS_TMP, f))) file.copy(file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", f), file.path(GOS_TMP, f))
}
```

```{r gos-null-classify}
# Step 2–4：n_hosts 零分布、MPD 零模型、分类 / Null models and classification.
nnull_16s <- gos_nhost_null(GOS_CFG$`16s`$merged_rds, GOS_CFG$`16s`$nhost_rds, N_ITER, SEEDS$gos)
nnull_its <- gos_nhost_null(GOS_CFG$its$merged_rds, GOS_CFG$its$nhost_rds, N_ITER, SEEDS$gos)
thr_16s <- gos_nhost_threshold(nnull_16s, "16s"); saveRDS(thr_16s, GOS_CFG$`16s`$threshold)
thr_its <- gos_nhost_threshold(nnull_its, "its"); saveRDS(thr_its, GOS_CFG$its$threshold)
gos_mpd_null(GOS_CFG$`16s`$merged_rds, HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$`16s`$mpd_rds, N_REP, SEEDS$gos)
gos_mpd_null(GOS_CFG$its$merged_rds, HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$its$mpd_rds, N_REP, SEEDS$gos)
z16 <- gos_z_scores(GOS_CFG$`16s`$merged_rds, HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$`16s`$mpd_rds,
                    GOS_CFG$`16s`$info_csv, "16s")
zit <- gos_z_scores(GOS_CFG$its$merged_rds, HOST_DIST_RDS, GOS_CFG$its$mpd_rds,
                    GOS_CFG$its$info_csv, "its")
cl16 <- gos_classify(z16, thr_16s$threshold, ALPHA)
clit <- gos_classify(zit, thr_its$threshold, ALPHA)
data.table::fwrite(cl16, GOS_CFG$`16s`$classified, sep = "\t")
data.table::fwrite(clit, GOS_CFG$its$classified, sep = "\t")
for (ds in c("16s", "its")) {
  cfg <- GOS_CFG[[ds]]; cl <- if (ds == "16s") cl16 else clit
  gos_extract_fasta(cl$ASV_ID[cl$category == "generalist"], cfg$ref, cfg$gen_fa)
  gos_extract_fasta(cl$ASV_ID[cl$category == "specialist"], cfg$ref, cfg$spe_fa)
  gos_extract_tax(cl$ASV_ID[cl$category == "generalist"], cfg$tax, cfg$gen_tax)
  gos_extract_tax(cl$ASV_ID[cl$category == "specialist"], cfg$tax, cfg$spe_tax)
}
```

```{r gos-threshold-figure}
# FigS6A/B：n_hosts 实际 vs 零分布 / Observed versus null n_hosts.
nhost_panel <- function(res, thr, colour, title) {
  act <- res$actual_count; nul <- res$null_count; nit <- res$n_iter; x_max <- 50
  ts <- 1:min(length(act) - 1L, x_max)
  d <- rbind(data.table(n_hosts = ts, count = as.numeric(act[ts + 1L]), distribution = "Actual"),
             data.table(n_hosts = ts, count = nul[ts + 1L] / nit, distribution = "Null (avg/iteration)"))
  d[, y := log10(count + 1)]
  ggplot(d, aes(n_hosts, y, fill = distribution)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .7, alpha = .85, colour = "black", linewidth = .1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = thr, linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick", linewidth = .6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Actual = colour, `Null (avg/iteration)` = "gray65")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x_max), breaks = seq(0, x_max, 5)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sprintf("threshold = %d (dashed); %d iterations", thr, nit),
         x = "n_hosts (number of host species)", y = "log10(Number of ASVs + 1)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
}
save_panel(nhost_panel(nnull_16s, thr_16s$threshold, "#4E79A7", "16S seed microbiota"), "FigS6A_n_hosts_threshold_16S", 8, 5)
save_panel(nhost_panel(nnull_its, thr_its$threshold, "#81B29A", "ITS seed microbiota"), "FigS6B_n_hosts_threshold_ITS", 8, 5)
```

```{r gos-sankey}
                   its_tax[, .(ASV_ID = taxid, Class)],

          "#E07A5F", "#90DBF4", "#641E16", "#A7C957", "#D35400")
cols_it <- stats::setNames(rep(PAL1, length.out = length(its_order)), its_order)
```

```{r gos-forests}
# FigS7A–C / FigS8C–E：跨层级 HBS 森林图 / Taxon HBS forests.
forest_plot <- function(d, rank_name, colour) {
  d <- d[rank == rank_name & is.finite(OR) & is.finite(OR_lo) & is.finite(OR_hi)]
  d[, taxon := factor(taxon, levels = taxon[order(OR)])]
  ggplot(d, aes(x = OR, y = taxon)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = OR_lo, xmax = OR_hi, colour = direction), size = .35) +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Increasing = colour, Decreasing = "#547FB6", `Not significant` = "grey55"), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Odds ratio (host-breadth slope)", y = NULL, colour = NULL, title = rank_name) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
hbs16 <- fread(file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", "precomputed", "taxon_hbs_results_16s.tsv"))
hbsit <- fread(file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", "precomputed", "taxon_hbs_results_its.tsv"))
for (r in c("Phylum", "Order", "Genus")) {
  letter <- c(Phylum = "A", Order = "B", Genus = "C")[[r]]
  save_panel(forest_plot(hbs16, r, "#D55E00"), paste0("FigS7", letter, "_Taxon_HBS_", r, "_16S"), 6, 7)
}
for (r in c("Class", "Order", "Genus")) {
  letter <- c(Class = "C", Order = "D", Genus = "E")[[r]]
  save_panel(forest_plot(hbsit, r, "#D55E00"), paste0("FigS8", letter, "_Taxon_HBS_", r, "_ITS"), 6, 7)
}
```

```{r gos-logistic-3x3}
# Fig4C 与 FigS8B：属级 two-part 3×3 / Genus two-part encoding.
genus_3x3 <- function(d, dataset = c("16S", "ITS")) {
  dataset <- match.arg(dataset)
  w <- data.table::dcast(d, Genus ~ term,
                         value.var = c("OR", "FDR", "estimate"))
  w <- w[is.finite(OR_x_zero) & is.finite(OR_x_pos)]
  w[, state_zero := ifelse(
    !is.na(FDR_x_zero) & FDR_x_zero < 0.05 & estimate_x_zero < 0, "Negative",
    ifelse(!is.na(FDR_x_zero) & FDR_x_zero < 0.05 & estimate_x_zero > 0,
           "Positive", "Not significant"))]
  w[, state_pos := ifelse(
    !is.na(FDR_x_pos) & FDR_x_pos < 0.05 & estimate_x_pos < 0, "Negative",
    ifelse(!is.na(FDR_x_pos) & FDR_x_pos < 0.05 & estimate_x_pos > 0,
           "Positive", "Not significant"))]
  w[, `:=`(
    state_zero = factor(state_zero,
                        levels = c("Negative", "Not significant", "Positive")),
    state_pos = factor(state_pos,
                       levels = c("Negative", "Not significant", "Positive")))]
  labs3 <- w[state_zero != "Not significant" |
               state_pos != "Not significant"][
    order(pmin(FDR_x_zero, FDR_x_pos))]

  p <- ggplot(w, aes(log2(OR_x_zero), log2(OR_x_pos),
                     colour = state_pos, shape = state_zero)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(size = if (dataset == "16S") 2.4 else 2.6,
               alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = labs3, aes(label = Genus),
      size = if (dataset == "16S") 3.12 else 2.9,
      colour = "black", seed = 20261107, max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.7, point.padding = 0.5,
      min.segment.length = 0, force = 2,
      max.time = 10, max.iter = 100000, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = "#2E86C1", "Not significant" = "grey65",
                 "Positive" = "#E67E22"),
      name = "Host-breadth slope\n(x_pos)") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = 25, "Not significant" = 16, "Positive" = 15),
      name = "One-host association\n(x_zero)") +
    labs(x = "log2 OR - one-host association (h=1 vs NRH)",
         y = "log2 OR - host-breadth slope (per doubling, h >= 1)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = if (dataset == "16S") 11 else 9) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

  if (dataset == "16S") {
    p + labs(
      title = sprintf("16S: two-part genus-host breadth associations (%d genera)",
                      nrow(w)),
      subtitle = paste("FDR<0.05; colour = host-breadth slope,",
                       "shape = one-host association (3x3)"))
  } else {
    p + labs(
      title = sprintf("ITS: two-part genus-host breadth (%d genera)", nrow(w)),
      subtitle = "FDR<0.05; colour = x_pos; shape = x_zero") +
      theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5))
  }
}
save_panel(genus_3x3(fread(file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", "precomputed", "genus_logistic_twopart_16s.tsv")), "16S"),
           "Fig4C_Genus_two_part_3x3_16S", 11.25, 9)
save_panel(genus_3x3(fread(file.path(SERVER_DIR, "gos", "precomputed", "genus_logistic_twopart_its.tsv")), "ITS"),
           "FigS8B_Genus_two_part_3x3_ITS", 4, 3)
```
